issue.title: Repo mentions in the prompt — highlight, preview, and jump
issue.description: Repo names typed into any ACE prompt input (`sase-core`, `chezmoi`, `gh:owner/repo`) are highlighted in their own color with the same underlined link affordance glossary terms already use, and `K` / `Ctrl+]` open a repo card and the repo itself.

issue.title: Repo mention catalog
issue.description: catalog: build the project-scoped repo mention catalog — identifier selection rules, the Rust-compiled matcher, the exact-identifier and path-adjacency span filters, and config declaration ranges.

issue.title: Prompt highlighting
issue.description: highlight: warm the catalog off the render path from the ACE app and overlay repo mentions in the prompt with a distinct bold underlined lavender style, including a PNG snapshot proving it reads apart from the glossary blue.

issue.title: K opens the repo card
issue.description: preview: add the repo preview card `K` opens for the mention under the cursor, with kind/description/checkout/clone/remote/declaration detail and copy, edit, and view actions.

issue.title: Ctrl+] opens the repo
issue.description: jump: make `Ctrl+]` on a repo mention open that repo's checkout in the editor or a tmux pane, add a declaration choice to the jump action chooser, and handle repos that are not cloned yet.

DISCOVERED ISSUE: phase sase-p2.2 closed at 2026-08-18T00:45:45Z with its six Justfile --epic-symbol entries still keyed to that phase bead, so `just _lint-symvision` (and therefore every agent's mandatory `just check`) now fails repo-wide while this epic is still in progress.

REPRODUCTION: `just check` on a tree whose only diff is an unrelated refactor (splitting src/sase/completion/candidates/catalog.py) passes fmt/keep-sorted/ruff/mypy/flags/pyscripts/test-waits/changelog/terminology and then fails at lint (symvision) with six identical errors: "--epic-symbol 'sase-p2.2(<symbol>)': bead 'sase-p2.2' is closed. Remove this stale --epic-symbol entry and clean up the symbol." Entries are Justfile lines 336-341: EditorRepoMentionCatalog, EditorRepoMentionCatalogResult, RepoMentionSpan, editor_repo_mention_catalog_for_project, lookup_repo_mention, scan_repo_mentions.

CONFIRMED UNRELATED TO THE REPORTING DIFF: re-running the same symvision invocation with only those six entries dropped reports exactly those six symbols in src/sase/xprompt/repo_mention_catalog.py as unused public defs and nothing else -- i.e. the whitelist is still doing real work and the symbols are simply not consumed yet.

WHY IT LANDS ON THIS EPIC: the symbols' intended consumer is phase sase-p2.3 (K opens the repo card), which is IN_PROGRESS. The exemptions are still legitimate; they are just keyed to a bead that closed early. The fix is to retarget lines 336-341 to the still-open bead that will consume them (sase-p2.3, or the epic sase-p2) rather than to delete the symbols. RELATED: task sase-o7 tracks the systemic version of this gap.

STEP 2 - INTEGRATED. Reviewed all non-epic commits since fb16cfaf8. No integration code changes were needed. VERIFICATION RUN, AND THE ONE REAL DEFECT IT FOUND. sase-p2.4 had run only 'just check' (diff-scoped lane), so this landing ran the full 'just check-full' plus 'just test-visual'. That surfaced a genuine sase-p2 regression: tests/test_keymaps_display_help.py:306 still asserted the old Ctrl+] help label 'Jump to xprompt/skill/file' after fd2d71afc relabeled the row to 'Jump to xprompt/skill/file/repo'. The scoped lane never selected that file, which is exactly the miss check-full exists to catch. Fixed and committed as 9a3327a3b 'test(ace): expect the repo-aware Ctrl+] help label'; tests/test_keymaps_display_help.py now passes 37/37, and it was the only stale reference to the old string in the repo.

FULL RESULTS. Full suite (test-cost lane): 1 failed, 32811 passed, 13 skipped -- the single failure was the help-label test above, now fixed. Visual suite: 2 failed, 700 passed, 1 skipped. Both visual failures reproduce deterministically in isolation, are unrelated to this epic, and are attributed below. check-full itself aborted early at lint (symvision) on entries owned by other epics, so its remaining gates were run individually: toobig, SASE validation, and committed plans all passed; selection-health --fail-on-new-flake failed on pre-existing records. Because symvision sits at Justfile line 680, that abort is also what hid the later gates from the earlier run.
